code: export function timeAgo(dateStr){const now=Date.now();const then=new Date(dateStr).getTime();const diff=Math.max(0,now-then);const mins=Math.floor(diff/60000);if(mins<1)return'just now';if(mins===1)return'1 minute ago';if(mins<60)return`${mins} minutes ago`;const hrs=Math.floor(mins/60);if(hrs===1)return'1 hour ago';if(hrs<24)return`${hrs} hours ago`;const days=Math.floor(hrs/24);if(days===1)return'Yesterday';if(days<30)return`${days} days ago`;const months=Math.floor(days/30);if(months===1)return'1 month ago';if(months<12)return`${months} months ago`;const years=Math.floor(months/12);if(years===1)return'1 year ago';return`${years} years ago`;}
